# microkeys

> A tiny (about 2 kB), fast, type-safe keybinding library for TypeScript, inspired by tinykeys.

- [Docs](https://microkeys.dhrv.pw/docs/): syntax, options, formatting, lower-level API
- [Docs as markdown](https://microkeys.dhrv.pw/docs.md)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/0xdhrv/microkeys)
- [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/microkeys)
